pairs: In tempore illo misit Merodach Baladan,
sent letters and gifts to Hezekiah.
audierat enim quod ægrotasset et convaluisset.
For he had heard that he had fallen ill and had recovered.
Lætatus est autem super eis Ezechias, et ostendit eis cellam aromatum,
And Hezekiah rejoiced over them, and he showed them the storehouses of his aromatic spices,
and of the silver and gold,
and of the perfumes and precious ointments,
and all the repositories for his belongings,
et universa quæ inventa sunt in thesauris ejus.
and all the things that were found in his treasures.
Non fuit verbum quod non ostenderet eis Ezechias in domo sua,
There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion,
that Hezekiah did not show them.
Introivit autem Isaias propheta ad Ezechiam regem,
Then Isaiah the prophet entered before king Hezekiah,
and from where did they come to you?”
De terra longinqua venerunt ad me,
“They came to me from a far away land,
“What did they see in your house?”
Omnia quæ in domo mea sunt viderunt;
“They have seen all the things that are in my house.
non fuit res quam non ostenderim eis in thesauris meis.
There was nothing that I did not show them among my treasures.”
“Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:
Ecce dies venient, et auferentur omnia quæ in domo tua sunt,
Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house,
et quæ thesaurizaverunt patres tui usque ad diem hanc,
and all that your fathers have stored up, even to this day,
will be taken away to Babylon. There will be nothing left behind,
et erunt eunuchi in palatio regis Babylonis.
And they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”
“The word of the Lord which he has spoken is good.”
Fiat tantum pax et veritas in diebus meis!
